user.title: Chore Tracker
user.description: Enter the Chore Tracker server URL and an API token (ct_…). On Home Assistant OS use the app hostname, for example http://816670ef-chore-tracker:8080 — not the ingress path.

data_description.url: Base URL including scheme and port (no trailing slash required).
data_description.token: Household API token from Settings → API tokens.

hassio_confirm.title: Chore Tracker discovered
hassio_confirm.description: Supervisor discovered Chore Tracker at {url} ({name}). Confirm to finish setup.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the Chore Tracker server.

abort.cannot_connect: Could not reach the discovered Chore Tracker server.
